Kai: Whos up for a quick lunchtime 'Slam Dunk' fantasy? 6 people, $3 buy-in, winner picks next week's snacks. :basketball: :money_with_wings:
June: In. Ill only play if theres nachos. :nachos:
Ravi: Count me in. Can we do a 10-min live draft at 12:30 so its fast?
Monica: Ill stream my camera and provide dramatic commentary. Loser has to wear a paper crown for an hour. :crown: :laughing:
Pete: Im tentative — meetings at noon. If draft is 12:30 Ill try to make it. Also proposing a MVP sticker prize.
snack-bot: Poll created: "Slam Dunk Lunch" (Yes: :thumbsup:, Maybe: :shrug:, Spectate: :eyes:)
Kai: Draft rules: 2 rounds, snake draft, 2-min pick timer. Quick and violent. :boom:
June: Nachos confirmed. Ill bring guac. Also vote: crown for loser or ritual coffee purchase? React :crown: or :coffee:.
Ravi: Coffee + crown. Compromise. :coffee: :crown:
Monica: Ill take play-by-play duty. Also can someone grab a tablecloth so the snack station looks fancy?
Pete: If I miss draft Ill accept an auto-pick and the shame. Could someone DM me picks after?
Kai: Draft at 12:30 in lounge. Sign up by 12:20 here. Link: https://tinyurl.com/slamdunk-signup (name + slack handle).
June: Signed. Nachos are non-negotiable.
Ravi: Signed. See yall lunchtime for chaos and cheese.
